Supported knee extension.name: Supported knee extension
Supported knee extension.instructions: Sit tall with your back supported. Slowly straighten one knee, pause, then lower with control.
Supported knee extension.clinical_note: Low-load movement option; stop if pain increases.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hip, knee, and ankle are visible
corrective_feedback.range: Move through your comfortable range of motion
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement

Seated heel slide.name: Seated heel slide
Seated heel slide.instructions: With your foot supported, slide your heel toward the chair and return slowly.
Seated heel slide.clinical_note: Use a comfortable range and follow clinician instructions.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hip, knee, and ankle are visible
corrective_feedback.range: Slide heel smoothly through pain-free range
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement

Standing hamstring curl.name: Standing hamstring curl
Standing hamstring curl.instructions: Hold a stable support, keep your thighs aligned, and gently bend one knee backward.
Standing hamstring curl.clinical_note: Keep the movement controlled and use support for balance.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hip, knee, and ankle are visible
corrective_feedback.range: Lift heel toward glute without arching back
corrective_feedback.incorrect: Keep thighs parallel and posture upright
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement

Supported sit-to-stand.name: Supported sit-to-stand
Supported sit-to-stand.instructions: From a firm chair, lean slightly forward and stand using your legs. Sit down slowly.
Supported sit-to-stand.clinical_note: Use a chair and supervision if needed.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hip, knee, and ankle are visible
corrective_feedback.range: Extend knees fully to standing position
corrective_feedback.incorrect: Do not collapse inward at the knees
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement

Supported weight shift.name: Supported weight shift
Supported weight shift.instructions: Hold a stable support and gently shift weight from one leg to the other without twisting.
Supported weight shift.clinical_note: Balance work should be supervised when necessary.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hips and feet are visible
corrective_feedback.start: Shift weight to your other side
corrective_feedback.range: Maintain controlled pelvic sway within comfortable boundary
corrective_feedback.incorrect: Keep your knees soft and avoid sudden shifts
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement

Gentle seated range of motion.name: Gentle seated range of motion
Gentle seated range of motion.instructions: Sit supported and move the knee only through a comfortable range, slowly and smoothly.
Gentle seated range of motion.clinical_note: For higher grades, obtain clinician guidance before exercise.

corrective_feedback.missing_landmarks: Move so your hip, knee, and ankle are visible
corrective_feedback.range: Work strictly within your pain-free zone
corrective_feedback.incorrect: Avoid sharp or forced joint movements
corrective_feedback.no_pose: Move into frame so your body is visible
corrective_feedback.too_fast: Move more slowly through the movement
